projectDescription: Vivix is a real-time content infrastructure platform that lets developers build interactive avatar experiences — from live streaming avatars to asynchronous AI video generation.
keyFeatures: Real-time Streaming Avatar with live interaction and control channel (WSS)
Blazing Fast Video Generation for asynchronous AI avatar video
TRTC-based media streaming for low-latency avatar sessions
Single unified API with shared authentication and response envelope
Multiple avatar models: vivix-a1-stream, vivix-a1, vivix-a1-lite, vivix-w1
Client SDK templates for rapid Streaming Avatar integration
Customer Support, Live Performance, Interactive Learning, and Interactive Worlds use cases
publicApiSurface: POST /v1/streaming-avatar/sessions — create a streaming avatar session
DELETE /v1/streaming-avatar/sessions/:id — close a streaming avatar session
WSS control channel — drive avatar actions in real time
POST /v1/video-generation/tasks — submit an asynchronous video generation task
GET /v1/video-generation/tasks/:id — poll task status and retrieve playback URL
GET /v1/models — list models enabled for your API key
